TextEntry.note: whether a player is typing: Output's own state, read by the platform after each frame

DrawnView.note: a view as drawn for a player this frame, its place in the window, its own size and its camera: Output's own state, which the cursor is turned through

Cursor.note: the cursor's mode a player's game asks, Normal, Hidden or Locked: Output's own state, read by the platform after each frame

PadLock.note: the game letting go of a player's pad lock, each time it turns on: Output's own state, read after each frame

Mesh.note: what an entity draws, a built-in shape: a prefab that lists only a mesh is drawn, at its transform, in its material

Material.note: how a drawn entity's surface looks, the standard lit material: white, not metallic, half rough by default

Camera.note: a view of the world drawn for a player, looking along its entity's -Z

Light.note: a directional light, shining along its entity's -Z

Environment.note: the world's ambient light and background
